description: This file defines the VacancyListRestController class, a REST API controller responsible for retrieving a list of job vacancies. It handles GET requests to provide vacancy data, utilizing various services and models. The class also implements security and validation for request parameters and specifies the API's response structure.

classes.name: VacancyListRestController
classes.description: A REST controller for handling vacancy listing requests in the recruitment module. Supports GET method to retrieve vacancy data with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes GET requests to fetch a list of vacancies, applying filters for status, publication, sorting, and pagination, then returns normalized vacancy data along with total count.
